Summary: Command to status value feedback operation for double indexed descriptions having hex representation.
Preconditions:
1. Use “0_sta j 2 sf_CommandFeedback_PGE_13-Bit Configuration_ForTesting.csv” as the exchange CSV configuration.
2. Set the bits per MCD to 16 from tools->Properties->Point tab.
3. For a MCD point, assign the description as [10bx:10ax].
Actions:
1. Open ASE2000 in RTU mode.
2. Select PGE protocol in exchange mode and import the configuration CSV file. Set the bits per MCD to 16 from tools->Properties->Point tab.
3. Start RTU.
4. Open ASE2000 in Master mode and repeat Step 2.
5. Issue Basic MCD having RTU ID as 40 and LUN address 1.
6. Issue Open Select/Close Select having sequence number 0bx, RTU ID 40 and LUN address 1.
7. Then issue pulse having RTU ID 40.
8. Issue Basic MCD having RTU ID as 40 and LUN address 1.
Expected Results:
1. Confirm whether the control operations sequence is displayed in line monitor.
2. Confirm whether the value of MCD point with description [10bx:10ax] in the Point List on the RTU side updates to 0-0 after completing step 7.
3. Confirm the Point List values on the RTU side are reflected on the Master side after completing step 8.

Summary: Performing File Write and Read operation without increment values for configured points.
Preconditions:
1. The common address utilized should be the one used for configuring points. For example, if the common address "10" was used for configuring points of type Single Point, then same common address "10" must be used during read operations.
2. Set Information Address with the value used during write operation, say 123.
3. Set Name of file as Transparent.
Actions:
1. Open ASE2000 in Task mode.
2. Select ‘Edit’ > ‘Configure RTUs...' to open ‘Configure RTUs Wizard’ page.
3. On the line marked *, provide the device Name, Id and select IEC104 protocol from the Protocol drop-down list. Proceed by clicking 'Next'.
4. Select Point Type as Single-Point, Measurand Normalized, Measurand scaled and Integrated Totals. Enter ‘First Point Id’, and ‘Point Count’ say 5 for each of this point in point configuration display along with Common address, say 10. Click the ‘Finish’ button to exit the Configure RTUs Wizard.
5. Switch to RTU Simulation Mode and start RTU.
6. Open another instance of ASE2000 in task mode. By default this instance will open in Master Simulation mode else switch to this simulation mode.
7. Verify that the selected device matches the one configured in RTU mode. If not, repeat step 2, check the 'Display' checkbox for the desired device, and then select 'Finish'.
8. Click on Connect Button to establish connection between the master and slave. Select Initialization > Start DT and use ‘Send Once’ to send initialization request.
9. Read general interrogation, counter interrogation and read command using ‘Send Once’ button.
10.Select File Operations > Write file.
i. Set Common Address to match the initial common address value used for point configuration,(say 10).
ii. Set Information address (Eg. 123).
iii. Select local file with some content and set Name of file as Transparent.
iv. Use ‘Send Once’ to verify that it works
11.Select Read file
i. Set Common Address, Information address and Name of file to match those used in write operation, say 10, 123 and Transparent respectively
ii. Select a local file path and set file name to create a new file.
iii. Use ‘Send Once’ to verify that it works
Expected Results:
1. Check the request and response messages in Line monitor and Messages tab.
2. Verify after completion of read or write operation, master is sending “last section/segment” as second last request which on treenode expansion show “section transfer without deactivation (Last Segment)” under ASDU subnode.
3. Verify after completion of read or write operation, master is sending “last section/segment” as last request which on treenode expansion show "file transfer without deactivation (Last Section)" under ASDU subnode.
4. Verify the file is created with the contents in the specified location after read operation.
Remarks: Case applicable only for file upto size 498kb.

Summary: Performing File Write and Read operation with increment values for configured points in balanced transmission mode.
Preconditions:
1. Connect BCOM-USB. Make proper connections neseccerry for loopback connection.
2. Check whether balanced mode is enabled.
3. The common address utilized should be the one used for configuring points. For example, if the common address "10" was used for configuring points of type Single Point, then same common address "10" must be used during read operations.
4. Set Information Address with the value used during write operation, say 123.
5. Set Name of file as Transparent.
Actions:
1. Open ASE2000 in Task mode.
2. Select ‘Edit’ > ‘Configure RTUs...' to open ‘Configure RTUs Wizard’ page.
3. On the line marked *, provide the device Name, Id and select IEC101 protocol from the Protocol drop-down list. Proceed by clicking 'Next'.
4. Select Point Type as Single-Point and Measurand scaled. Enter ‘First Point Id’, and ‘Point Count’ say 5 for each of this point in point configuration display along with Common address, say 10. Click the ‘Finish’ button to exit the Configure RTUs Wizard.
5. Select 'Tools' > 'Properties' to open 'Properties' page. Now select 'IEC 60870-5-101' > 'Options' check the 'Enabled' checkbox displayed in 'Balanced Mode Options' area and click 'OK'.
6. Assign increment values to the points in the PointList tab. Switch to RTU Simulation Mode and start RTU.
7. Open another instance of ASE2000 in task mode. If not already in Master Simulation mode, switch to this. Verify that the selected device matches the one configured in RTU mode. If not, repeat step 2, check the 'Display' checkbox for the desired device, and then select 'Finish'.
8. Click on Connect Button to establish connection between the master and slave. Select Initialization > Link Status & Rest Link and use ‘Send Once’ to send initialization request.
9. Read general interrogation, counter interrogation and read command using ‘Send Once’ button.
10.Select File Operations > Write file.
i. Set Common Address to match the initial value used for point configuration,(say 10).
ii. Specify Information address (Eg. 123).
iii. Select a local file with content and set Name of file as ‘Transparent’.
iv. Use ‘Send Once’ to verify functionality.
11.Select Read file
i. Set Common Address, Information address and Name of file to match those used in write operation (say 10, 123 and Transparent respectively).
ii. Choose a local file path and specify a new file name.
iii. Use ‘Send Once’ to verify functionality.
Expected Results:
1. Check the request and response messages in Line monitor and Messages tab.
2. Verify increment operation after step 9.
3. Verify the file is created with the contents in the specified location after read operation.
Remarks: Case applicable only for file upto size 498kb. Need to wait for amble amount of time until the read operation completes.

Summary: Step command to analog translation operation for single indexed descriptions with decimal increment value.
Preconditions:
1. Import a DNP3 LAN-WAN exchange csv configuration file with necessery descriptions added.
2. For a AI point, assign the description as [DOAI:0ax:2].
3. Set Transmit flag for the Analog Input exchange.
4. Disable UDP listen by checking 'Disable UDP Listen' in 'Simulation' subtab under 'DNP3 LAN/WAN' tab.
5. Add 'Dest' value in 'Class 1/2/3/0 Data' to where control comand is to be executed. For ex: if 'Direct Operate Relay' has 'Dest' as 1, then set 'Dest' as 1 for 'Class 1/2/3/0 Data'.
Actions:
1. Open ASE2000 in exchange mode with protocol selected as DNP3 LAN/WAN. Import the configuration CSV file.
2. Select 'Tools' > 'Properties' to open Properties window. Under the 'DNP3 LAN/WAN' tab:
[i]. In 'Simulation' subtab, check 'Disable UDP Listen'.
[ii]. In 'Options' subtab, input host and port. Click OK.
3. Switch to RTU mode of simulation.Start RTU.
4. Repeat Step 1 and 2. If not in Master simulation mode , switch to it. Change 'Dest' value of 'Class 1/2/3/0 Data' to the RTU Id where control comand is executed. For ex: if 'Direct Operate Relay' has 'Dest' as 1, then set 'Dest' as 1 for 'Class 1/2/3/0 Data'.
5. Issue Analog Input with 'Dest' as 1.
6. Edit the exchange object properties: type, value and point index of Direct Operate Relay as Latching relay, Latch off and 10 respectively. Click OK and issue Direct Operate Relay with 'Dest' as 1.
7. Issue Class 1/2/3/0 Data with 'Dest' as 1.
Expected Results:
1. Confirm whether the value of AI point with description [DOAI:0ax:2] in the Point List on the RTU side decrements by 2 after completing step 6.
2. Confirm the Point List values on the RTU side are reflected on the Master side after completing step 7.

2. For a AI point, assign the description as [DOAI:0bx:!12:10].
3. Set Transmit flag for the Analog Input exchange.
4. Disable UDP listen by checking 'Disable UDP Listen' in 'Simulation' subtab under 'DNP3 LAN/WAN' tab.
5. Add 'Dest' value in 'Class 1/2/3/0 Data' to where control comand is to be executed. For ex: if 'Direct Operate Relay' has 'Dest' as 1, then set 'Dest' as 1 for 'Class 1/2/3/0 Data'.
Actions:
1. Load the a2k generated using commandline arguments. (For steps refer the attached document in the remarks).
2. Select 'Tools' > 'Properties' to open Properties window. Under the 'DNP3 LAN/WAN' tab:
[i]. In 'Simulation' subtab, check 'Disable UDP Listen'.
[ii]. In 'Options' subtab, input host and port. Click OK.
3. Switch to RTU mode of simulation.Start RTU.
4. Repeat Step 1 and 2. If not in Master simulation mode , switch to it. Change 'Dest' value of 'Class 1/2/3/0 Data' to the RTU Id where control comand is executed. For ex: if 'Direct Operate Relay' has 'Dest' as 1, then set 'Dest' as 1 for 'Class 1/2/3/0 Data'.
5. Issue Analog Input with 'Dest' as 1.
6. Edit the Direct Operate Relay exchange object properties: qualifier as One point, value as Close and point index as 12. Click OK and issue Direct Operate Relay with 'Dest' as 1.
7. Issue Class 1/2/3/0 Data with 'Dest' as 1.
Expected Results:
1. Confirm whether the value of AI point with description [DOAI:0bx:!12:10] in the Point List on the RTU side have no change after completing step 6.
2. Confirm the Point List values on the RTU side are reflected on the Master side after completing step 7.
Remarks: ASE2K_CommandLineRunningSteps.txt
